Notifications/events appearing one by one — great 'activity feed' hero visual. Unstyled; you style the items with bg-card etc. Imports motion/react.
Blur + fade-in on mount or in view; the go-to entrance wrapper for sections and image grids (stagger with `delay`). Colourless. Respect prefers-reduced-motion yourself.
Per-word/char/line text entrance with ~10 presets (blurIn, slideUp, scaleUp…). Inherits colour — good default for hero headlines over Aceternity's text effects.
Count-up number for stats sections. Hard-codes text-black dark:text-white — pass className="text-foreground" (or font-heading) to theme it.
SVG beams flowing between refs — the 'integrations' diagram (your app in the middle, tools around it). Default gradient is orange→purple: set gradientStartColor/StopColor to var(--primary).

Light travelling around a card's border; subtle way to highlight one pricing tier or the hero screenshot. colorFrom/colorTo default orange/purple — pass var(--primary). Parent needs `relative overflow-hidden rounded-*`.
Spotlight-follows-cursor card (bg-background surface). Gradient defaults are purple/pink hex and it imports next-themes — pass gradientFrom/To from the theme; drop next-themes if you don't use it.
Feature bento with icon + hover CTA. Hard-codes neutral-*/black alpha colours and needs @radix-ui/react-icons — prefer @oc/feature-bento, or swap to bg-card/text-muted-foreground.

Quiet SVG dot background (also grid-pattern / interactive-grid-pattern / flickering-grid). Dots use currentColor on a hard-coded text-neutral-400/80 — pass className="text-muted-foreground/40" plus a radial mask.
Pill button whose label slides out for an arrow + primary fill on hover. Uses bg-primary/text-primary-foreground — one of the few fully token-based Magic UI pieces.

Animated terminal with typing + sequenced lines for CLI/dev-tool heroes. bg-background/border-border (only the traffic-light dots are literal colours). Imports motion/react even though the registry lists no deps.
Lightweight WebGL globe (cobe) — much cheaper than Aceternity's three.js globe. Colours are RGB arrays in the config (white base, orange markers); tune to your palette. One per page.

Light/dark toggle with a View Transitions clip-path reveal. Colourless (icons use currentColor). Uncontrolled it toggles <html class=dark> + localStorage itself; with next-themes pass theme/onThemeChange instead.

Full TanStack data table: search, column filters, visibility toggles, row selection, delete, pagination. Best free 'admin table' starting point. Pulls Origin's own table/button/select primitives (see gotchas).

Event calendar (month/week/day/agenda, drag-and-drop, event dialog) — a whole feature for free. Heavy: dnd-kit, date-fns, @remixicon/react, ~12 primitives. Event colours are a fixed palette (sky/amber/violet/rose/emerald/orange).
Searchable combobox (popover + command) with label — drop-in for long select lists.
Multiselect with removable tag chips + search. Uses Origin's `multiselect` primitive (not in stock shadcn).
Search input with ⌘K kbd hint — standard app header search field.
Password input with show/hide toggle.
Command palette (command + dialog) with search — pair with comp-25 as the trigger and bind ⌘K yourself.
Avatar upload with crop dialog + zoom slider. Uses Origin's cropper primitive and use-file-upload hook.
Range calendar (react-day-picker) for date-range filters.
App navbar with breadcrumb, notification popover and user menu — complete product header. Logo is a placeholder SVG.
File/folder tree (headless-tree) — docs nav, file explorers.
Stepper for multi-step forms / onboarding (Origin's stepper primitive, not in stock shadcn).
Timeline (Origin's timeline primitive) — changelogs, order history, activity.
Cookie/GDPR consent notification with buttons. Small and token-based; wire up persistence yourself.
Char/word staggered entrance on scroll (GSAP SplitText + ScrollTrigger). Inherits colour. The React Bits headline effect; needs gsap + @gsap/react.
Words blur-in one by one (motion). Inherits colour; lighter than SplitText (no GSAP).
Rotating keyword in a headline with staggered letter transitions (motion). Unstyled — put bg-primary/text-primary-foreground on the pill yourself.
Typewriter with cursor, multiple strings, delete/retype (GSAP). Inherits colour.
Scramble → reveal text on hover or in view (motion). Dev-tool/brutalist brands.
Animated stats counter with separators/decimals (motion). Inherits colour.
Paragraph that un-blurs and fades in word by word as you scroll — manifesto/about sections. GSAP ScrollTrigger.
Shimmer sweep across text, e.g. a hero eyebrow. Default colours #b5b5b5/#fff are props — set from your muted/foreground tokens.
Animated gradient text/border. Default palette is React Bits purple/pink — always pass colors from your theme.
WebGL aurora backdrop (ogl, ~small). colorStops default to React Bits purple/green — pass your --primary hexes. Lazy-load; one per page.
Interactive dot grid that reacts to cursor/click (GSAP + InertiaPlugin). baseColor/activeColor are hex props (default purple).
three.js light beams backdrop — striking but heavy (three + @react-three/fiber + drei). Use only for a hero, lazy-loaded.
Logo marquee with fade edges and hover-pause; supports node or image logos. fadeOutColor defaults to #0b0b0b/#fff — set it to your background.
Bento grid with spotlight, border glow, particles and tilt (GSAP). Hard-coded dark palette (#120F17 cards, #2F293A borders, text-white) — only for dark sites, or rework colours.
Most flexible text entrance primitive (per char/word/line, presets + custom variants, trigger prop). Unstyled — inherits theme. Install via @motion-primitives or `npx motion-primitives add`.
Card that morphs into a dialog (shared layout) — the signature motion-primitives piece for galleries/case studies. Only the backdrop has colour (white/black 40%); you style the card with tokens.
Sliding highlight behind the hovered/active item (tabs, nav, segmented controls). You pass the bg class (e.g. bg-muted), so it follows the theme.
Animated content swap between tab panels/steps (AnimatePresence wrapper). Colourless.
Infinite marquee with speedOnHover and vertical mode; alternative to magicui/marquee using motion + react-use-measure.
Animate children when they enter the viewport — thin, reusable wrapper. Colourless.
Stagger a group of children with presets (fade, blur, slide, zoom…). Colourless; good for feature lists and logo rows.
Odometer-style rolling digits (spring). Inherits colour; pair with in-view for stats.
Layered backdrop-filter blur gradient for edges of scroll areas/images. Colourless; backdrop-filter costs GPU — keep blurLayers low.
Shimmer sweep for 'Thinking…' / loading text. Colours come from --base-color/--base-gradient-color defaults (zinc) — override via className.
Toolbar that expands into a search/input panel. Hard-codes zinc/white — swap to bg-popover/border/text-muted-foreground before using.
Compound multi-step onboarding (StepIndicator, ChoiceGroup, FeatureCarousel, TipsList; controllable state). Fully token-based — the safest Cult UI pick for app UI.
Feature-announcement/onboarding modal with media steps, 'don't show again' and responsive dialog↔drawer. Tokens throughout (black only on the media frame). Pulls 6 shadcn primitives.
Small rolling-digit number (motion). Inherits colour.
Base UI tabs with an animated glowing 'halo' indicator. Surfaces use tokens, but the halo glow is a hard-coded cyan/purple/pink palette. Needs @base-ui/react.
Input with animated focus halo + validation states. Tokens for border/text, Vercel-style rainbow hex for the glow — retint for your brand. @base-ui/react + motion.
AI prompt composer with attachments/actions and a shader glow. Mostly tokens, but teal/blue hex accents and @paper-design/shaders-react + @base-ui/react are heavy deps.
Apple Dynamic Island that morphs between sizes/states — fun status/notification widget. Hard-coded black pill; fine on any theme as a 'device' element.
Tabs whose content slides in the direction of travel. Hard-codes neutral-600/700 + white text — swap to bg-muted/text-foreground.
Button that morphs into a small inline form (feedback, waitlist). Text uses tokens but surfaces are bg-white / dark:bg-[#121212] plus blue accents — swap to bg-popover.
Compound card that expands to reveal details (motion + react-use-measure). Mostly bg-muted/ring-border, but one bg-white surface — check dark mode.
Hero with animated dithering shader backdrop (@paper-design/shaders-react); text/card layer uses tokens, shader colour is a hex prop.
Browser-window frame for screenshots/demos; mostly tokens with literal traffic-light colours.

Full Gantt chart (draggable features, sidebar groups, markers). Fully token-based. Deps: dnd-kit, jotai, date-fns, lodash.throttle, @uidotdev/usehooks.
Composable drag-and-drop kanban (dnd-kit + tunnel-rat). Token-based; you bring the data model.
File dropzone (react-dropzone) with empty/content states. Token-based; pairs with stock shadcn forms.
Figma-style colour picker (saturation/hue/alpha/eyedropper/format). Surfaces use tokens; the colour gradients are intrinsic.
Shiki code block with tabs, line numbers, highlight/diff/focus transformers and copy. Theme-aware chrome; diff colours are semantic emerald/rose. Heavy: shiki + react-icons.
GitHub-style contribution heatmap; levels use fill-muted-foreground/N, so it inherits the theme.
TipTap rich-text editor with slash commands, bubble menu, tables. Token-based UI but ~18 tiptap/lowlight deps — only when you truly need rich text.
Tag picker built from badge + command + popover.
'New feature →' pill above a hero headline (compound badge). Token-based.
Tabbed install-command snippet with copy (npm/pnpm/bun). Ideal for dev-tool landing pages.

QR code (qrcode lib) that reads --foreground/--background at runtime — but only parses oklch() values; our DESIGN.md themes emit hex, so it silently falls back to near-black/white. Pass foreground/background props. Server variant included.

Shared-element layoutId: a tab underline / pill that glides between items. The free, hand-rolled way to animate tabs, nav highlights and segmented controls — about 10 lines with `layoutId`. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.

`layout` prop: elements animate to their new size/position when state changes (expanding cards, accordion rows, reflowing grids). No height hacks. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.

AnimatePresence exit: modals, toasts and removed list items animate OUT instead of vanishing. The fix for 'abrupt' close. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.

AnimatePresence `mode` (sync / wait / popLayout): how to swap one view for another — tab panels, carousel slides, step wizards — without overlap jank. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.

whileInView: fade/slide sections and cards in as they enter the viewport. Use with @oc/motion-presets fadeUp + once:true. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.

useScroll + useTransform: progress bars and parallax tied to scroll position. Medium-intensity; keep it to one element per viewport. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Header that hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up (useMotionValueEvent). Great default for marketing navbars. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Reorder: drag-to-reorder lists with automatic layout animation — settings lists, kanban columns, playlists. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
drag + constraints + momentum: draggable cards, swipeable panels, sliders. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
pathLength: SVG line drawing for icons, checkmarks, signatures and diagrams. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Button whose label rolls to a new word on hover/click — a free alternative to Motion+ text components. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Character counter that animates as you type and warns near the limit — input feedback done right. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Element that follows the cursor with spring lag — custom cursors and spotlight followers without Motion+ Cursor. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Words light up as you scroll through a paragraph — the classic manifesto/hero statement reveal. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Minimal three-dot pulse loader (variants + repeat). Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.
Product flies into the cart along an arc() path with a spring impact — e-commerce delight. Free example (motion is MIT); copy and adapt the source from the example page.

Human-in-the-loop approval card: the chosen option expands to fill the card and the alternatives collapse away, so the decision reads as final; destructive options get bg-destructive/10. All shadcn tokens (bg-background, border-border, text-muted-foreground) and useReducedMotion throughout — the free, theme-aware alternative to beautifui/approval-card (no foundation.css --accent clash). Pass resolvedId when replaying a transcript.

Collapsible tool-invocation row (name, summary, args/result panel) whose status ring breathes while pending, spins while running, then draws a check or cross. Chrome is theme tokens; the success/error ring colours are fixed oklch green/red — swap for your semantic tokens if the design system defines them. Status is also announced via sr-only text. Pairs with smoothui/ai-task-list.

Live agent plan: nested steps with a drawn checkmark on completion and a travelling underline on whichever step is running. Theme tokens + fixed oklch success/danger accents; honours reduced motion. The best free 'what is the agent doing' checklist — drive it from real step events, never a timer.

Collapsible reasoning trace: the label shimmers 'Thinking' only while isStreaming, then settles to 'Thought for 3.2s' (measured, or pass duration) and auto-collapses — until the user toggles it, after which it stops deciding for them. Muted-foreground chrome, inherits the theme; no shimmer under reduced motion.

Three small AI waiting indicators (dots, sweep bar, 3×3 pixel grid) sharing one cycle length so they can be mixed on a page, with an optional elapsed-seconds counter, aria-live and an sr-only label. Drawn in currentColor — set the text colour and it follows the theme. Lighter than canvas orbs for inline 'working…' states; use oc/agent-status for the primary agent indicator.

Prompt composer: autogrowing textarea, attachment chips, Enter-to-send and a send button that becomes Stop while streaming (the two lucide icons swap — not a true path morph, despite the description). Theme tokens. Pulls @smoothui/ai-core, imported by relative path (../ai-core), so keep both under components/smoothui/.

Context-window meter: a ring that fills and shifts to amber at warningAt / red at dangerAt without ever changing size, with a token breakdown on open. Warning/danger colours are fixed oklch; the rest is tokens. Good for chat headers and agent consoles that should show budget pressure quietly.

Wrap real content in <Skeleton loading> and it renders an invisible copy with a pulsing overlay of exactly the same size — no hand-sized placeholder boxes, zero layout shift when data lands. No deps; bg-muted-foreground/20 + Tailwind animate-pulse. Does NOT honour reduced motion — add motion-reduce:animate-none. Pair with transitions/skeleton-reveal for the crossfade out.

Tab list with a layoutId spring indicator in underline, pill or segment variants; arrow/Home/End keys and roving tabindex. Pill/segment use bg-muted + bg-background (theme). The underline uses bg-brand from SmoothUI's tokens.json (pink by default) — set --brand: var(--primary) once in globals.css. Tabs only: you render the panels (pair with motion-primitives/transition-panel).

Floating pill navbar that tightens its padding after 120px of scroll, hides on scroll-down and returns on scroll-up, with a layoutId pill behind the active link. bg-background/90 + backdrop-blur, theme tokens; focus ring uses brand. Positioned absolute — pass className="fixed" for a page navbar. Hide-on-scroll is disabled under reduced motion. Marketing pages only (see the navigation playbook's scroll-aware direction).

3D coverflow (rotateY + depth + scale per offset) with drag/swipe, arrow keys, optional autoplay and an aria-live slide announcer; drag turns off under reduced motion (the upstream hasReducedMotion flag is wrong — the code uses useReducedMotion). Cards are bg-background with a foreground/10 ring. Prev/next come from @smoothui/smooth-button (auto-installed), which uses SmoothUI's smooth-N grey ramp from tokens.json.

Tinder-style swipe deck: drag past a threshold or press ←/→ to commit; Like/Nope stamps and tinted washes fade in with the drag; imperative swipeLeft/swipeRight/reset handle; aria-live announcements; reduced-motion aware. Like uses text-green from SmoothUI's tokens.json, Nope uses text-destructive; the heavy inline card shadow is tuned for light backgrounds. Labels are props.

Reading-progress indicator in four variants (bar, ring, rolling percent number, segmented), spring-smoothed via useScroll, for the window or a scroll container. Default colour is var(--color-brand) from tokens.json — pass color="var(--primary)" (or define --brand). Articles, docs and long onboarding pages.

Copy button that cycles idle → spinner → check with icon cross-fades, an aria-live status and a 44px hit target; icons are props. bg-background + border, spinner has motion-reduce:animate-none. Its className is string-concatenated (no cn()), so conflicting utility classes won't merge — override via a wrapper if needed.

name: sliding-underline-tabs
title: Sliding Underline Tabs
description: A compact tab switcher with an orange underline that glides between labels.
notes: CSS-only: one bar translated under the active label (750ms ease-out) plus a 650ms keyframe nudge on the panel; motion-reduce handled. A prop-less demo — 3 hard-coded tabs, #f97316 bar, light-dark() hex greys, and the active label is text-white, which vanishes on a light background. Lift the technique onto your own tabs with bg-primary / text-foreground.

name: sliding-content-tabs
title: Sliding Content Tabs
description: A compact tab switcher with a sliding active surface and content transition.
notes: A solid slab slides behind the active icon+label tab (translateX, 750ms ease-out). Despite the description the content swap is a keyed remount with no animation, and there is no reduced-motion guard. Hard-coded demo tabs and #f97316 slab — take the slab technique, use bg-primary + text-primary-foreground.

name: expanding-icon-tabs
title: Expanding Icon Tabs
description: An icon bar where the chosen tab widens to reveal its label and the rest of the row slides over to make room.
notes: Icon toolbar whose chosen item widens to show its label while siblings slide over; ←/→ move focus, Escape and outside-click collapse it, role=toolbar, motion-reduce handled. Good for compact app toolbars and view switchers. Hard-coded items and light-dark() hex colours — rebuild with your icons and tokens.

name: spotlight-indicator
title: Spotlight Indicator
description: A glowing rail that slides to the active item in a vertical nav — the same indicator powering this site's sidebar.
notes: Vertical-nav indicator: JS measures the active item and a 2px glowing rail transitions top/height (300ms). Lovely for sidebars and settings nav. No reduced-motion guard; orange #f97316 glow and hex greys are hard-coded — use var(--primary) for the rail and its box-shadow.

name: magnetic-fill-button
title: Magnetic Fill Button
description: A magnetic pill button with a bottom-to-top background fill.
notes: Zero-dependency magnetic button: pointermove writes CSS vars (14%/22% of the cursor offset) that translate the pill, and a fill rises bottom-to-top on hover/focus (380ms). Much lighter than Motion-based magnets. No reduced-motion guard on the translate; the outline, text and #f97316 fill are hard-coded — use border-foreground and a bg-primary fill with text-primary-foreground.

name: icon-swap-button
title: Icon Swap Button
description: A leading icon slides out as an arrow opens in to take its place, trading without changing the button's width.
notes: On hover/focus-visible the leading icon (an Apple mark in the demo) collapses out while an arrow opens in on the other side, so the button never changes width (520ms ease-out transitions on width/margin/opacity). Great for download/CTA buttons. No reduced-motion guard; light-dark() hex colours.

name: secure-purchase-button
title: Secure Purchase Button
description: A purchase button that opens room for a pixel-wave loader, swaps it for a shield once the payment clears, then resets itself.
notes: Stateful pay button: idle → processing (pixel-wave loader opens room beside the label) → secured (shield) → resets, with data-state, aria-busy and an aria-live label; motion-reduce handled. The states advance on setTimeout in the demo — drive them from your real payment promise. Hard-coded colours.

name: scrub-number-field
title: Scrub Number Field
description: A number field you drag to scrub and click to type, with a ruler that tracks the gesture.
notes: Figma-style scrubbable number input: drag horizontally to change the value (Shift ×10, Alt ×0.1, re-based mid-drag), click to type, a ruler tracks the gesture and the field nudges at its bounds (keyframe disabled under reduced motion). Pointer capture, no deps. Min/max (0–100) and colours are hard-coded constants — lift them into props. Settings panels and design-tool UIs.

name: blur-glide-menu
title: Blur Glide Menu
description: A nested menu whose steps blur before they glide aside, while the surface animates to the height of the step arriving.
notes: Nested menu (role=menu/menuitem, aria-haspopup, back button) where the outgoing step blurs then glides aside while the surface animates to the incoming step's height — a CSS-keyframe take on the multi-view drawer. motion-reduce shortens every transition. Demo data and colours are hard-coded.

name: staggered-letter-text-swap
title: Staggered Letter Text Swap
description: A surface-free text interaction with a staggered per-letter upward replacement.
notes: Each letter rolls up and is replaced by its twin with a 34ms stagger on hover/focus-visible — pure CSS transitions via a --letter-delay var; the button carries aria-label and the letter spans are aria-hidden; motion-reduce handled. Remove the hard-coded font-[Arial] and light-dark() text colour so it inherits your type and tokens. Nav links and text CTAs.

name: liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass (@samasante/liquid-glass)
description: Headless React lens that refracts what's behind it — Apple-style Liquid Glass with frost, tint, rim light, dispersion and an edge 'bend'; can also refract a copy of a node, an image, video or canvas.
notes: Wrap any styled box in <Glass> (your translucent background is the tint; children stay crisp; optics via the optics prop). True refraction of the live page is Chrome/Edge only (backdrop-filter: url()); Safari/Firefox fall back to frost + tint + edge light. To bend in every browser, give it geometry (size + center) to refract its own children, or refract={copy} / src for images, video and canvas (WebGL). Headless — tint it with your tokens. v0.1.x: pin the version; use one or two lenses per screen and check text contrast over busy backgrounds. React >=18 peer, zero runtime deps, MIT.

name: animejs
title: anime.js v4
description: Framework-agnostic JavaScript animation engine: timelines, staggers, SVG morphing / line drawing / motion paths, draggables, scroll observers, text splitting and layout animations for CSS, SVG, DOM attributes and JS objects.
notes: Reach for it over Motion when choreography is the point: long multi-element timelines (createTimeline), grid staggers from center, SVG morphTo / createDrawable line drawing / createMotionPath, createDraggable, onScroll, and a free splitText (Motion's is Motion+). Vanilla JS — no React components: run it in useEffect inside createScope({ root }) and call revert() on unmount. For presence, layout and gestures in React, Motion stays the default. See catalog/sources/motion.md.
